description: This file defines data structures, enums, and interfaces related to NGAP handover procedures in a 5G network, including handover requests, responses, status transfers, and associated context information.

classes.name: ngap_ue_source_handover_context
classes.description: Holds context information for UE handover source, including PDU sessions and RRC container.

classes.name: ngap_handover_preparation_request
classes.description: Represents a request to prepare for handover, including UE and gNB identifiers and PDU sessions.

classes.name: ngap_handover_preparation_response
classes.description: Response indicating success or failure of handover preparation.

classes.name: ngap_qos_flow_info_item
classes.description: Contains information about QoS flows, including forwarding status.

classes.name: ngap_drbs_to_qos_flows_map_item
classes.description: Maps DRBs to associated QoS flows.

classes.name: ngap_pdu_session_res_info_item
classes.description: Details about PDU session resources, QoS flows, and DRB mappings.

classes.name: ngap_erab_info_item
classes.description: Information about ERABs, including ID and forwarding status.

classes.name: ngap_cell_type
classes.description: Represents the size category of a cell.

classes.name: ngap_last_visited_ngran_cell_info
classes.description: Stores info about the last visited NG-RAN cell, including ID, type, stay duration, and cause.

classes.name: ngap_last_visited_cell_item
classes.description: Wraps last visited NG-RAN cell info.

classes.name: ngap_source_ngran_node_to_target_ngran_node_transparent_container
classes.description: Contains data for transparent transfer during handover between NG-RAN nodes.

classes.name: ngap_handover_request
classes.description: Handover request message with details about UE, cause, security, PDU sessions, and optional info.

classes.name: ngap_qos_flow_item_with_data_forwarding
classes.description: QoS flow info with optional data forwarding acceptance.

classes.name: ngap_data_forwarding_resp_drb_item
classes.description: DRB items with optional forwarding tunnel info.

classes.name: ngap_ho_request_ack_transfer
classes.description: Acknowledgment transfer for handover request, including QoS flows and data forwarding.

classes.name: ngap_pdu_session_res_admitted_item
classes.description: Details of admitted PDU sessions post-handover.

classes.name: ngap_target_ngran_node_to_source_ngran_node_transparent_container
classes.description: Contains data for transparent transfer from target to source NG-RAN during handover.

classes.name: ngap_handover_resource_allocation_response
classes.description: Response to resource allocation request, indicating success, admitted sessions, and failure info.

classes.name: ngap_drb_status_ul_t
classes.description: Uplink DRB status info including SN size and count.

classes.name: ngap_drb_status_dl_t
classes.description: Downlink DRB status info including SN size and count.

classes.name: ngap_drbs_subject_to_status_transfer_item
classes.description: DRB status transfer info for UL and DL.

classes.name: ngap_ul_ran_status_transfer
classes.description: UL status transfer message for a UE.

classes.name: ngap_dl_ran_status_transfer
classes.description: DL status transfer message for a UE.
